The results of two independent surveys are shown in the table below.

| Teenagers' Daily Screen Time |  |  |  |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Group | Sample size | Mean ($hours$) | Standard deviation ($hours$) |
| $A$ | $1, 200$ | $5.0$ | $1.4$ |
| $B$ | $1, 200$ | $5.0$ | $2.3$ |

Which statement is true based on the table?

1. Group $B$ included the teenager with the highest daily screen time.
2. The Group $A$ data set was identical to the Group $B$ data set.
3. The daily screen times in Group $B$ had a larger spread than those in Group $A$.
4. The median daily screen time of Group $B$ is greater than the median daily screen time of Group $A$.

The results of two independent surveys are shown in the table below.

| Employees' Daily Emails Sent |  |  |  |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Group | Sample size | Mean ($emails$)$ | Standard deviation ($emails$)$ |
| $C$ | $1, 050$ | $48$ | $11$ |
| $H$ | $1, 050$ | $48$ | $15$ |

Which statement is true based on the table?

1. Group $H$ included the employee with the highest daily emails sent.
2. The Group $C$ data set was identical to the Group $H$ data set.
3. The daily emails sent in Group $H$ had a larger spread than those in Group $C$.
4. The median daily emails sent of Group $H$ is greater than the median daily emails sent of Group $C$.
